Online bookkeeping questions

Is online bookkeeping done by a real person?

Yes. All our bookkeepers are in-house and located in Manitoba, near Winnipeg. You get one dedicated bookkeeper who knows your business.

Do you offer virtual bookkeeping outside Winnipeg?

Yes. We work with businesses in Winnipeg, Brandon and across rural Manitoba. You never need to visit our office.

I use QuickBooks. Can you take over my books?

Yes. We migrate your bookkeeping from QuickBooks or any other software and keep everything continuous. If you ever leave, you get your full books back in Excel and PDF. We use our own secure systems, so you don't pay for extra third-party software.

Is my financial data safe with a remote bookkeeper?

Your data is protected with AES-256 encryption and strict internal rules on who can access it. Our bookkeepers are our own staff in Manitoba, not outsourced.

Do you handle Manitoba GST/PST filing?

Yes. GST/PST filing is part of the $299/month Bookkeeping plan, together with T4/T5 filing and payroll for up to 3 employees.

How much does online bookkeeping cost in Manitoba?

Our Bookkeeping plan is $299/month for businesses with less than 100 monthly transactions. If you also want corporate and personal tax filing, the Bookkeeping & Tax plan is $499/month.

How fast do you answer?

Our plans include a 24-hour response guarantee. Your questions go to your own bookkeeper, not a ticket queue.
